mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, phone, email, nickname, avatar, bio, level, experience, role, openid, province, city, district, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{bio}, #{level}, #{experience}, #{role}, #{openid}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET avatar = #{avatar}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user ORDER BY experience DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id as userId, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.level, COUNT(DISTINCT c.date) as totalDays FROM user u LEFT JOIN checkin c ON u.id = c.user_id GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.level ORDER BY totalDays DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.id as userId, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.level, COUNT(DISTINCT c.date) as totalDays, COALESCE(streak_data.streakDays, 0) as streakDays FROM user u LEFT JOIN checkin c ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as streakDays FROM ( SELECT user_id, date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY date DESC) as rn FROM checkin WHERE date <= #{today} GROUP BY user_id, date ) consecutive_dates WHERE DATEDIFF(#{today}, date) = rn - 1 GROUP BY user_id ) streak_data ON u.id = streak_data.user_id GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.level, streak_data.streakDays ORDER BY totalDays DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM user u INNER JOIN goal g ON u.id = g.user_id WHERE g.type = #{goalType} AND u.id != #{excludeUserId} LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM user ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM user WHERE id != #{excludeUserId} ORDER BY experience DESC
SELECT type FROM goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active'
SELECT * FROM user WHERE id != #{excludeUserId} AND (phone = #{keyword} OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY experience DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET level = #{level}, experience = #{experience}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.level, u.province, u.city, u.district, COALESCE(checkin_stats.totalCheckins, 0) as totalCheckins, COALESCE(checkin_stats.totalDays, 0) as totalDays, COALESCE(checkin_stats.checkinRate, 0) as checkinRate FROM user u INNER JOIN goal g ON u.id = g.user_id AND g.status = 'active' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.user_id, COUNT(*) as totalCheckins, COUNT(DISTINCT c.date) as totalDays, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT c.date) * 100.0 / GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MIN(c.date)) + 1, 1), 1) as checkinRate FROM checkin c WHERE c.status = 'approved' GROUP BY c.user_id ) checkin_stats ON u.id = checkin_stats.user_id WHERE u.id != #{excludeUserId} AND g.type = #{goalType} ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.province = #{province} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, checkinRate DESC LIMIT 30
